review: AI bibliographic checks; no human or domain review

strategy.bounds: 25 accepted records per batch; at most 40 exact-DOI verification queries per batch
strategy.discovery: Four groups of four thematic searches across coatings, chemistry, printing, foams, fibers and durability. Exact-DOI queries screened 116 candidates; 100 accepted after source and identity checks.
strategy.limitations: Indexed publisher access strongly favors MDPI. This is a practical topical expansion, not a systematic or publisher-balanced literature review.
